sprites.name: moon_jack_o_lantern
sprites.notes: Concept B - the Halloween moon REDONE FROM SCRATCH in round 1d: edge and holes cut by hand, no coordinate from the shipped face, no outer ring (a choice written in the source). The only moon with holes.

sprites.name: star_sparkle
sprites.notes: Concept B 'Scissors' - REDRAWN in phase 2 / Part A for configuration 1 (s = radius/16, 10-13 real px): a full waist (24-28 units, 27-31% of the radius) in place of round 1a's ~12, the unequal points unchanged (N 82, E 78, S 74, W 76), concave two-segment sides with a wobble, sixteen written vertices. 180x180 canvas, the shipped sprite's scale and anchor; the call site does not change. Photographed ONLY with configuration 1 applied in a throwaway build (without it, at 6 px, the shape does not count - round 1d).
